title: Spelling of Braud and his birthplace
summary: Braud explains his father changed the family name from Breaux and says he was born near Brookstown, Louisiana.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I didn't know. That was a very good one. Oh, one other little point. That was on the record strange. How do you spell your last name?

My last name? I spelled my last name B-R-A-U-D. But the proper way to spell it my name is B-R-E-A-U-X. But Brow was such a large family. I was amongst some of them Sunday. And then some of the bros hadn't never seen me before. seen you before because some of them weren't born. So it looked like the mail would get mixed up. And so we just, my father just changed the last name.
Your father changed the name? The name, the last name. But my name
is Bro, B-R-E-A-U-X. So that's the way all the Bro's spelled. On our family, we were in the same section. And they were all farmers and bricklayers, so they lived all in the same section.
How far up the river is that where you were born?
Oh, that's about 65 miles from there. A little place they call Brookstown, Louisiana.
